comments.author: hbosch
comments.story: How Peppa Pig became a video nightmare for children
comments.why: Funny, technical tale of viewers abusing a talking banana bot
comments.text: You might enjoy this video. It’s part humor and part technical discussion on how his talking “Banana” bot was brigades by users on Twitch in an effort to make him say racist words and phrases. After he got a strike on Twitch, he patched the software and then it got circumvented... terrific little video about the battle between him and his viewers and ultimately ends with his approach to sterilizing input so that the banana couldn’t speak anything harmful. I thought it was great. * [VIDEO]

comments.author: sorenjan
comments.story: The naughty username checking system used by Twitch
comments.why: Phonetic filter beat enumerating character permutations
comments.text: Reminds me of the guy that streamed a talking banana on Twitch, where viewers could make it say things. People submitted variations of the n-word and got him banned, and after trying to filter out all character combinations he could think of he wrote a phonetic filter. That apparently worked much better than trying to think of every permutation of characters that sounds like bad words. [VIDEO]
